alejandra: heads-up: cost dashboard shows tenant t-22 with negative prefetch savings (-$9.60). product just pinged. :grimacing:
nate: ugh. likely join issue between token_events and prefetched_credits after the ETL change last night
yuri: can you share a sample invocation id? i'll pull event rows
alejandra: inv: inv-332a. console rows: baseline_tokens=500, cached_tokens=300, net_billed=820 (should be 200)
kevin: that net implies double-counting. we recently changed to union prefetch/hotpath events and forgot to dedupe by invocation_id in the dashboard view
yuri: quick fix: change the view to aggregate per invocation first, then sum per tenant. sample SQL:
```
WITH per_inv AS (
  SELECT invocation_id, tenant, sum(token_cost) AS base, sum(coalesce(prefetch_credit,0)) AS credit
  FROM token_events
  LEFT JOIN prefetched_credits USING (invocation_id)
  GROUP BY invocation_id, tenant
)
SELECT tenant, sum(base) AS base, sum(base - credit) AS actual, sum(credit) AS credits
FROM per_inv
GROUP BY tenant;
```
nate: sounds safe. i'll push to staging and run a smoke for t-22
cost-bot: [smoke-run] started for tenant t-22 on staging
cost-bot: [smoke-run] completed: staging rollup shows savings +$6.20, per-invocation diffs look clean :white_check_mark:
alejandra: great. please add an alert if any tenant has savings < -$1 and add a note in econ-schema docs about dedupe by invocation_id
ate: filing alert PR and doc note now. leaving this thread until prod deploy. thanks!
